The '''Zuni cluster''' was near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Mair Koda]] made her living transporting goods between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the Zuni cluster.
